title: Miao Rebellion (1735–1736)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Miao Rebellion (1735–1736)", at revision 1378467232, opens: "The Miao Rebellion of 1735–1736 was an uprising of autochthonous people from southwest China." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q6827726, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "rebellion in China". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
